summary: Trinity Biotech plc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $4,354,314 in American Depositary Shares (each representing 20 ordinary shares) through agent Lucid Capital Markets. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. ADSs trade on Nasdaq under TRIB; offering is made under Rule 415(a)(4) with no minimum commitment, 3% agent compensation. Proceeds for general corporate purposes. No special-situation catalyst; monitoring is limited to dilutive impact of sales.
